verdict.rationale: Canny says it automatically captures feedback from Gong, Intercom, Slack and dozens of other sources, plus directly from customers on its Portal, which centralizes requests from both internal teams and customers in one place. Autopilot also pulls requests from support, sales and review platforms and call transcripts. The repository can be queried by theme and ARR impact through the MCP server. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of native in-app search or filtering of the repository, explicit mention of internal colleagues submitting requests directly, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
